cards.name: Is UXCam compliant with financial data security standards?

description.description: Yes. UXCam is GDPR and SOC 2 Type II certified. You can automatically mask sensitive user data (like account numbers, balances, personal info) before it ever leaves the device. We provide granular control over what’s captured and stored, ensuring full compliance with banking privacy regulations.

cards.name: Can UXCam capture behavioral analytics without exposing private data?

description.description: Absolutely. UXCam lets you define masking rules via SDK configuration. You can hide text fields, inputs, or screens that contain PII, while still tracking anonymized interactions such as taps, gestures, and navigation flows. Your team sees the what and why of friction, without seeing who the user is.

cards.name: How do finance companies typically use UXCam?

description.description: Common use cases include: Onboarding funnel optimization (improve KYC completion rates), Transaction flow analysis (reduce failed or abandoned payments), Feature adoption tracking (e.g., new investment tools or savings features), Error and crash diagnosis (debug app issues with session context)	and Product validation (understand user behavior after feature releases).

cards.name: What’s the impact of UXCam on app performance?

description.description: Minimal. UXCam’s SDK is lightweight (<1MB) and designed for regulated industries. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and recordings are processed asynchronously so app latency remains unaffected. You can also control sampling (e.g., record 10% of sessions).
